description: A figure region (here a text stand-in for an image, since this corpus can't encode real raster content) followed by its caption. The caption's own heuristic (is_caption) already recognizes the 'Figure N' prefix correctly, but the figure region itself has no heuristic at all -- RegionClass::Picture requires the still-unimplemented vision detector -- so it defaults to RegionClass::Text instead of being linked to its caption as a Picture.
